source.title: Imaging of nanoscale polar textures in quantum paraelectric SrTiO3
source.article_access_note: The final open-access article was manually reviewed from the authoritative Nature article page. GitHub Actions urllib requests returned a non-article cookie/shell response, so live HTML retrieval is not used as a scientific gate.

scientific_boundaries: The Nature article resolves that 23K, 91K, and 172K denote diffraction-pattern temperatures, but matching labels and the shared Zenodo record do not prove byte-exact source-TIFF-to-figure-panel identity.
The published 0.1 inverse-angstrom scale bar belongs to the rendered Figure 1d patterns and is not automatically a source-TIFF pixel calibration.
The publication's same-region temperature realignment statement belongs to the 4D-STEM workflow and is not evidence of SAED acquisition independence.
The publication's AFD superspot assignment is useful reference evidence but is not a complete frozen phase/reflection truth set for analyzer validation.
This snapshot is manually curated from the authoritative final publication; CI validates snapshot integrity and repository provenance, not live Nature page availability.
restart_or_recheck_conditions: The Nature article DOI, publication status, or data-availability record changes.
A machine-readable authoritative full-text source becomes available and can replace the manual capture without weakening the evidence boundary.
A later source-to-figure mapping audit finds evidence inconsistent with the captured temperature labels or scale-bar interpretation.
